_help: EXTRA LLM models. Entries can be plain ids ("org/model-id") or objects with id/label/description/speed. This file EXTENDS the built-in catalog in llm/model_catalog.py - it is safe to leave entries here forever. Unknown shapes never crash the server (they are ignored with a log line). A {"models": {...}} wrapper is also accepted. NOTE: the NVIDIA fallback stage always runs nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b first and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b second (config.py -> NVIDIA_STAGE_MODELS); this list only adds labels/extras for the API.

nvidia.label: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B
nvidia.description: Priority NVIDIA fallback (build.nvidia.com). Frontier reasoning, 262k context.

nvidia.label: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B
nvidia.description: Second NVIDIA fallback - only used when Ultra fails or times out.

openrouter.label: Qwen3 32B
openrouter.description: Default OpenRouter model. Strong structured output.
